# Scenario 04

## Input data

-   Total Landings: 1983-2024

-   Standardized Portuguese CPUE, from the commercial crustacean trawl fleet (1998-2024)

-   Nephrops survey offshore Portugal (NepS) (1997-2022)

-   Portuguese Autumn Groundfish Surveys (PtGFS-WIBTS-Q4) (200-500 m) (1990-2023) - DeltaGAM

```{r include=FALSE}
nep <- read.csv("nep.fu.2829_input.csv", header=TRUE, sep=";", dec=".")

nep <- nep %>%
  mutate(CPUE_norm=CPUE/(mean(nep$CPUE, na.rm=TRUE)),
         NepS_norm=NepS/(mean(nep$NepS, na.rm=TRUE)),
         IBTS_norm=IBTS/(mean(nep$IBTS, na.rm=TRUE)),
         IBTS_DeltaGAM_norm=IBTS_DeltaGAM/(mean(nep$IBTS_DeltaGAM, na.rm=TRUE)) )
```

# Model 03

## Create the SPiCT input object

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=8, dpi=300}
rm(inp)

prior_r <- 0.38
prior_r_sd <- 0.3

prior_sdi <- 0.1
prior_sdi_sd <- 0.3

prior_sdb <- 0.15
prior_sdb_sd <- 0.3

prior_sdc <- 0.1
prior_sdc_sd <- 0.3


inp <- list()

inp$timeC <- nep$Year
inp$obsC  <- nep$Catches
inp$timeI <- list(nep$Year + 0.5,
                  nep$Year + 9.5/12, ## mid of October
                  nep$Year + 5.5/12) ## mid of June
inp$obsI  <- list(nep$CPUE_norm,
                  nep$IBTS_DeltaGAM_norm,
                  nep$NepS_norm)


inp$priors$logalpha <- c(0,0,0)
inp$priors$logbeta  <- c(0,0,0)
inp$priors$logn     <- c(0,0,0) #disable logn prior when fixing n

inp$phases$logn <- -1     #fixing n to resemble the Schaefer production model
inp$ini$logn    <- log(2) #good practice to always define value for logn when fixing

inp$priors$logr   <- c(log(prior_r) - 0.5 * prior_r_sd^2, prior_r_sd, 1)
inp$priors$logsdb <- c(log(prior_sdb) - 0.5 * prior_sdb_sd^2, prior_sdb_sd, 1)
inp$priors$logsdc <- c(log(prior_sdc)-0.5*prior_sdc_sd^2,prior_sdc_sd,1)
inp$priors$logsdi <- list(c(log(prior_sdi)-0.5*prior_sdi_sd^2,prior_sdi_sd,1),
                          c(0,0,0),
                          c(0,0,0))

inp$nspinup <- 160

inp$stdevfacI <- list(rep(1, length(inp$timeI[[1]])),
                      rep(1, length(inp$timeI[[2]])),
                      rep(1, length(inp$timeI[[3]])))

cv <- sqrt(exp((nep$IBTS_DeltaGAM_upp - nep$IBTS_DeltaGAM_low) / (2 * 1.96)) - 1)
cv <- cv/mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE)
inp$stdevfacI[[2]][!is.na(cv)] <- cv[!is.na(cv)]
cv <- sqrt(exp((nep$NepS_upp - nep$NepS_low) / (2 * 1.96)) - 1)
cv <- cv/mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE)
inp$stdevfacI[[3]][!is.na(cv)] <- cv[!is.na(cv)]

inp$robflagi <- c(0,1,1) 

plotspict.data(inp, qlegend=TRUE)
plotspict.ci(inp)
```

## Fit the SPiCT model

```{r}
fit_Sc04_Mod03 <- fit.spict(inp)
fit_Sc04_Mod03 <- calc.osa.resid(fit_Sc04_Mod03)
fit_Sc04_Mod03 <- calc.process.resid(fit_Sc04_Mod03)
retrofit_Sc04_Mod03 <- retro(fit_Sc04_Mod03)
hc.fit_Sc04_Mod03 <- hindcast(fit_Sc04_Mod03, npeels=5)
retrofit_Sc04_Mod03_8p <- retro(fit_Sc04_Mod03, nretroyear=8)
hc.fit_Sc04_Mod03_8p <- hindcast(fit_Sc04_Mod03, npeels=6)  ## nao converge com mais de 7

fit_Sc04_Mod03
```

## Diagnostics check-list for acceptance

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=8, dpi=300}
# 1: Convergence: 0 => OK
retrofit_Sc04_Mod03$opt$convergence

# 2: Finite Parameters: TRUE => OK
all(is.finite(retrofit_Sc04_Mod03$sd))

# 3&8: Violatiom of model assumptions
sumspict.diagnostics(fit_Sc04_Mod03)

# 4: Retrospective pattern: should be between -0.2 and 0.2 (-20% and 20%)
mohns_rho(retrofit_Sc04_Mod03, what=c("BBmsy","FFmsy"))

# 5: Realistic production curve: if between 0.1 and 0.9 => OK
calc.bmsyk(retrofit_Sc04_Mod03)

# 6: Assessment uncertainty: if order of magnitude < 2 => OK)
calc.om(retrofit_Sc04_Mod03)

# 7: Initial Values sensitivity - jitter
#    if same estimates for all initial values => OK (The distance should preferably be close to zero)
sens.ini_Sc04_Mod03 <- check.ini(fit_Sc04_Mod03, ntrials=30)
sens.ini_Sc04_Mod03$check.ini$resmat

# 9: Hindcast
plotspict.hindcast(hc.fit_Sc04_Mod03, legend.pos=NA)
```

## Plots and tables
```{r}
#   FUNCTION TO SAVE DATA   #########################################################################################
xtab<-function(x,caption='Table X.', file=stdout(), width='"100%"', cornername='', dec=rep(1,ncol(x))){
  nc<-ncol(x)
  lin<-paste('<table width=',width,'>', sep='')
  lin<-c(lin,sub('$','</td></tr>',sub('\\. |\\.$','.</b> ',
                                      sub('^', paste('<tr><td colspan=',nc+1,'><b>',sep=''), caption))))
  hr<-paste('<tr><td colspan=',nc+1,'><hr noshade></td></tr>', sep='')
  lin<-c(lin,hr)
  cnames<-colnames(x)
  cnames<-paste(sub('$','</b></td>',sub('^','<td align=right><b>',cnames)), collapse='\t')
  lin<-c(lin,paste('<tr>',paste('<td align=left><b>',cornername,'</b></td>',sep=''),cnames,'</tr>'))
  lin<-c(lin,hr)
  rnames<-sub('$','</b></td>',sub('^','<tr> <td align=left><b>',rownames(x)))
  #x<-sapply(1:ncol(x),function(i)sub('NA','  ',format(round(x[,i],dec[i]))))
  x<-sapply(1:ncol(x),function(i)sub('NA','  ',formatC(round(x[,i],dec[i]),digits=dec[i], format='f')))
  for(i in 1:nrow(x)){
    thisline<-paste(rnames[i],paste(sub('$','</td>',sub('^','<td align=right>',x[i,])), collapse='\t'),'</tr>', sep='')
    lin<-c(lin,thisline)
  }
  lin<-c(lin,hr)
  lin<-c(lin,'</table><br>\n')
  writeLines(lin,con=file)
}



#- Function getAnnualCatch set up by A Kokkalis to extract annual catches (from B and F) for the 2 management years
getAnnualCatch <- function(rep) {
  b <- get.par("logB", rep, exp = TRUE) [,2]
  f <- get.par("logF", rep, exp = TRUE) [,2]
  data.frame(annual(rep$inp$time, b * f * rep$inp$dteuler, sum))
}
```

##### % probability of B < Blim
(!) Duvida se necessario ou não multiplicar por 100

```{r}
CI <- 0.95
bmsyfrac <- 0.5
TACyear <- c(2027, 2028) #(inp$maneval)


calc_BbelowBmsy <- function(man_obj, scenario, TACyear = NULL, CI = TRUE, bmsyfrac = 1, percent = FALSE) {
  
  BMSY <- get.par("Bmsyd", man_obj[[scenario]])[2]
  lBBmsy <- get.par("logBBmsy", man_obj[[scenario]], exp = FALSE, CI = CI)
  
  BlimBmsy <- 0.3
  
  ind <- if (is.null(TACyear)) nrow(lBBmsy) else 
    which(dplyr::between(as.numeric(rownames(lBBmsy)), TACyear[1], TACyear[2]))
  
  i <- ind[length(ind)]
  
  prob <- pnorm(log(1), mean = lBBmsy[i, 2], sd = lBBmsy[i, 4])
  
  return(prob)
}



scenarios <- c("15frac", "F=Fmsy", "F=Fsq", "F=0")

results <- sapply(scenarios, function(s) 
  calc_BbelowBmsy(man$man, s, TACyear, CI)
)

results * 100
```
